parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1293224. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard type IC50, exact standard relation '=', and non-null pChEMBL value. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
